MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is made as of January 15, 2025 by and between Example Corp, a fictional company ("Customer"), and Sample Services Ltd ("Supplier").

1. Definitions
"Services" means the hosting services described in Schedule A. "Fees" means the amounts payable under Section 4.

2. Term and Renewal
This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months. It renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives sixty (60) days written notice of non-renewal.

3. Services
Supplier shall provide the Services with reasonable skill and care and shall meet the service levels in Schedule B.

4. Fees and Payment
Customer shall pay a monthly fee of $5,000 USD. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days. Late amounts bear interest at 1.5% per month.

5. Confidentiality
Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information secret and use it only to perform this Agreement, for three (3) years after termination.

6. Limitation of Liability
Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss. Each party's total liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

7. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice.

8. Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings and representations, whether written or oral.

9. Counterparts
This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument.
